tagline.zh: 构建==可信==的生成式 AI

blurb.en: Asked for an ink painting, why does an image generator paint grapes in black-and-white ink but always paint a cake in color? We found what makes the result depend on the object being drawn, and fix this “object-level concept brittleness” without any training.
blurb.zh: 同样画一幅水墨画，为什么图像生成模型能把葡萄画成黑白水墨色，而却把蛋糕始终画成彩色的？我们找到了这种因为画的物体不同而产生差异的原因，无需训练即可修正这种“物体级的概念脆弱性”。

points.en: A concept keeps failing on a few objects whatever the seed: a systematic blind spot, not sampling noise.
points.zh: 同一个概念在少数物体上反复失败，换随机种子也一样：这是系统性盲区，而不是采样噪声。

points.en: Sparse autoencoders at every denoising step locate the missing or weakened concept dimensions.
points.zh: 在去噪的每一步训练稀疏自编码器，定位缺失或减弱的概念维度。

points.en: No retraining: concept consistency and repair rates rise markedly, and the earlier the intervention, the stronger the correction.
points.zh: 无需重新训练，概念一致性和修复成功率显著提升，而且越早干预、纠正效果越好。

blurb.en: Turning a photo into a painting, diffusion models invent things that were never there. One inversion step fixes it.
blurb.zh: 照片转油画时，模型会凭空“脑补”原图里没有的东西。一步反演就能修正。

points.en: The cause: added noise breaks the image's semantics, so U-Net upsampling links unrelated regions.
points.zh: 定位病因：加噪破坏了图像的语义完整性，让 U-Net 上采样在不相关的区域之间建立错误关联。

points.en: Training-free and plug-and-play: one DDIM inversion step of the reference image supplies the right features and correlations.
points.zh: 免训练、即插即用：对参考图做一步 DDIM 反演，就能得到正确的特征和关联。

points.en: Higher fidelity on COCO, ImageNet and ImageNet-R, and 11.2× faster than PnP and similar methods.
points.zh: 在 COCO、ImageNet 和 ImageNet-R 上保真度更高，比 PnP 等方法快 11.2 倍。

blurb.en: An AI that first maps how a research field evolved, then writes a fully cited survey along that map.
blurb.zh: 让 AI 先画出一个领域的“方法—实体”知识图谱，再沿着它写出一篇有据可查的学术综述。

points.en: A Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph records which methods extend, compete with or share resources with others, and becomes the survey's backbone.
points.zh: 用“方法—实体知识图谱”记录方法之间的延续、竞争和共享资源，作为综述的骨架。

points.en: Graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles recall over flat lexical baselines (p = 0.004).
points.zh: 图感知检索的召回率接近平面检索基线的两倍（p = 0.004）。

points.en: Citation audits find 80.6% of generated sentences fully or partly supported by the papers they cite.
points.zh: 引用核查：80.6% 的生成句子能在所引文献中找到完全或部分支撑。

blurb.en: LLMs still remember the rules you set; deep into a conversation they quietly stop following them. We found this collapse and measured it.
blurb.zh: 大模型还记得你定下的规则，却在长对话里悄悄不再遵守。我们发现并量化了这种“状态崩塌”。

points.en: 88.6% of failures are behavioral drift (remembering the rule but not following it) rather than forgetting.
points.zh: 88.6% 的失败是“记得但不做”的行为漂移，而不是遗忘。

points.en: StateTrack-Bench plants five kinds of persistent constraints and checks them at increasing dialogue depths, with a forked recall audit.
points.zh: StateTrack-Bench：五类持续约束，在不同对话深度检验，并用分叉回忆审计区分“记不住”和“不去做”。

points.en: Structured State Anchoring recovers up to 24.4 points.
points.zh: 结构化状态锚定最多可挽回 24.4 个百分点。

blurb.en: Code-writing agents try many programs in a search tree, and every failed branch teaches the others.
blurb.zh: 写代码的智能体在一棵搜索树上多路尝试，失败分支的经验会分享给其他分支，少走弯路。

points.en: Candidate programs grow into a search tree and run in a sandbox for feedback.
points.zh: 把多个候选程序组织成搜索树，在沙箱里执行获取反馈。

points.en: Failure diagnoses go into a shared memory that other branches retrieve; failed checks are told apart from missing evidence.
points.zh: 失败诊断写进全局记忆，供其他分支检索复用，并区分“检查未通过”和“证据不足”。

points.en: Beats direct generation in 8 of 10 model–dataset pairs on HumanEval and MBPP.
points.zh: 在 HumanEval 和 MBPP 上，10 组模型—数据集组合中有 8 组优于直接生成。

title.en: Introducing SurveyGraph: an AI framework that writes academic surveys on its own
title.zh: SurveyGraph：一套能自动写学术综述的 AI 框架

title.en: Your chatbot remembers the rules; it just stops following them
title.zh: 大模型记得规则，却不再遵守：揭示长对话中的“状态崩塌”

title.en: ReMCTS: code agents that learn from each other's mistakes
title.zh: ReMCTS：让写代码的智能体从彼此的失败中学习

title.en: Why diffusion models can sketch grapes but not cakes, and how to fix it
title.zh: 能画葡萄，却画不好蛋糕？解释并修复文生图模型的“概念脆弱性”

title.en: When “must” becomes “maybe”: how rules erode as AI agents hand off work
title.zh: 当“必须”变成“也许”：多智能体交接时，规则如何悄悄流失

title.en: Photo to painting without inventing things: one step, 11× faster
title.zh: 照片转油画不再“脑补”：一步反演，快 11 倍

about.en: MUSE Lab stands for **Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability**. The Muses were the Greek goddesses of art and inspiration: we want generative AI to be just as creative, and at the same time **controllable, interpretable and trustworthy**.
about.zh: MUSE Lab 的全称是 **Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability**，即“面向可解释性的多模态理解与生成”。MUSE 也是希腊神话中司掌艺术与灵感的缪斯女神：我们希望生成式 AI 像缪斯一样富有创造力，同时**可控、可解释、值得信任**。
